error_taxonomy.IAC_INPUT_INVALID: Corpus metadata or a fixture input violates the benchmark contract.
error_taxonomy.IAC_PARSE_ERROR: Guardian reported an error-level Terraform or Kubernetes diagnostic.
error_taxonomy.IAC_FINDING_MISMATCH: The exact security finding key set differs from ground truth.
error_taxonomy.IAC_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: A required finding source, file, or line is absent.
error_taxonomy.IAC_DIAGNOSTIC_MISMATCH: The exact parser diagnostic-code multiset differs from ground truth.
error_taxonomy.IAC_CLAIM_MISMATCH: A required cross-source claim or conflict count differs from ground truth.
error_taxonomy.IAC_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: A required identity-resolution outcome differs from ground truth.
error_taxonomy.IAC_PUBLIC_EXPOSURE_MISS: A labeled public-exposure event was not detected exactly.
error_taxonomy.IAC_ANALYZER_FAILURE: The pinned analyzer threw instead of returning a bounded result.
error_taxonomy.IAC_NONDETERMINISTIC: Two complete corpus runs produced different normalized output hashes.
error_taxonomy.IAC_INPUT_MUTATION: An input file changed while the benchmark was executing.
error_taxonomy.IAC_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH: The runtime package does not match its pinned source or artifact hash.
error_taxonomy.P5_GATE_INCOMPLETE: Technical evidence exists, but one or more governed closure gates remain open.
